title: Warehouse destination table entries: per-table match on $source_table and table required for row filters
answers: Destination with warehouse table filter runs on every row
Pick a table for each row filter validation error
Unfiltered warehouse table entry lets rows through filtered table
How are data_warehouse entries compiled into filters
body:
`_build_warehouse_table_filters` (posthog/cdp/filters.py) compiles each `data_warehouse` entry as `properties.$source_table = table_name AND <entry filters>`, ORed across entries. Every entry checks its table, otherwise an unfiltered entry would match rows of filtered tables. It only runs if some entry has properties.
- `WAREHOUSE_SOURCE_TABLE_PROPERTY` (`$source_table`) must stay equal to `DWH_SOURCE_TABLE_PROPERTY` in nodejs/src/cdp/schema/hogflow.ts.
- Save-time guard in posthog/cdp/validation.py `HogFunctionFiltersSerializer.validate`: an entry with properties but no `table_name` (or the "Select a table" placeholder) raises "Pick a table for each row filter." It must run before the placeholder is stripped, or the filter silently vanishes.
applies: Destinations/hog functions with source data-warehouse-table; filters.py compiler plus validation serializer
